title: Eat
body:
Syntax: eat <item>

Description: Eats food for immediate recovery or consumes medicine using the same effects as 'use'. Medicinal pills, antidotes, soldier pills and other medical items can be eaten. Medical healing still takes its configured duration and antidotes are preserved if you are not poisoned. Halloween Town candy also uses 'eat' for its healing and 15-minute experience bonus. Use 'eat 2.pill' to select an individual pill.

Date: 2026-08-17

Raw Farming crops (Carrot, Potato, Tomato, Onion, Pumpkin, Watermelon, Corn and Pepper) are edible. Cooked versions restore more Stamina than fresh crops. Use COOK <crop> with a held Cooking Pot or an owned apartment kitchen to prepare a stronger meal. Medicinal Herbs are not food.

All edible food now restores twice the former resource amount. A cooked Leviathan Fillet restores up to 5,000 Stamina, without exceeding your maximum. Drinks and medicine are unaffected.

Restorative medical items (Healing Salves, Soldier Pills, Medicinal Pills, and other healing medicine) cannot be used or eaten during PvE or PvP combat. Only ONE restorative medical treatment can be active at a time: a second item is not consumed and cannot start another heal until the first finishes, including after reconnecting. Healing already started before combat keeps its normal duration. Cure-only Antidote Pills do not restore resources and can still cure poison during combat or an active treatment.
